description.purpose: The one model call of the design lane: it turns a briefed request into a draft manifest. `provider` names the WIRE PROTOCOL, not the vendor, so any OpenAI-shaped endpoint serves -- including the stub the scenario suite starts, which is why the composed class is provable at zero cost.
description.not_in_scope: No parsing and no trust: whatever it answers is read by `normalise` before it becomes a manifest. And no boot-time demand: all three variables carry an EMPTY default. This hive travels inside the OS shell, and a shell that could not be grown without a model credential would make the FAST LANE -- which asks no model at all -- conditional on one. A colony with no composer configured still rewires an edge; what it cannot do fails at call time, loudly, and not at boot. The completion budget is 16384 rather than a manifest's worth of tokens: a reasoning model spends its budget on reasoning first, and inside a LOOP the thread grows with every round, so the same cap is asked of a longer prompt each time (plans/welle-2026-08-27/receipts/builder-messreihe.md).
